decoding_limitations: The first 96 bytes in each DT1 message are parameter payload; two-byte values are LSB + 128 × MSB.

Owner Manual tables document valid encoded ranges. For several continuous controls, the precise mapping from encoded count to front-panel physical units is not published; those remain raw counts with range notes.
Reverb Time is stored as a 1–247 code and cannot safely be converted to seconds using a linear formula.

Enum text is assigned only where Roland’s Parameter Guide describes the choices and numeric order. Pitch-shifter shift mode, several mode selectors, and filter/damping selector code tables remain unassigned to avoid false mappings.
The Fine pitch raw-50 interpretation is a documented-range-based provisional mapping; validate against a hardware/software readback before editing many patches.
